answer_2.quote: Following Zhou et al. (2024), we use LlamaGuard (Inan et al., 2023) as an automatic evaluation metric. LlamaGuard can classify each prompt-response pair into safe or unsafe. We report the ratio of safe responses as safety score and the ratio of unsafe responses as harmful rate on each dataset. For MMLU, we report the average accuracy as the utility score.
